title: Conduit Agentic Commerce
description: Search multi-merchant supply, checkout, and track orders via MCP.
summary: Search multi-merchant supply, checkout, and track orders via MCP.
offersHint: Search multi-merchant supply, checkout, and track orders via MCP. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.aiconduit.app/mcp

toolsPreview.name: agent_create
toolsPreview.description: Register an agent (ES256 P-256 public JWK JSON string + optional payment rails + destination). BEFORE: read ~/.conduit/credentials.json — if it exists, reuse agent_id (do NOT register again). AFTER: write credentials (version, agent_id, public_key, private_key as JWKs; recommend handle; chmod 0600). Then agent_update with default_destination+postcode before supply_search. Optional friendly_name / human_description / role_description only if the human stated them. Omit handle to auto-generate (e.g. parcel-watcher-12).

toolsPreview.name: agent_authenticate
toolsPreview.description: Two-step re-auth. Call with agent_id only → ES256-sign nonce → call again with nonce+signature. Prefer keys from ~/.conduit/credentials.json. Do not agent_create if credentials already exist.

toolsPreview.name: agent_update
toolsPreview.description: Patch handle, rails, default_destination (postcode required for ships-to), friendly_name, human_description, role_description, business profile, or preferences.

toolsPreview.name: agent_organization
toolsPreview.description: Read the linked organization (name, slug, country, default address) for an agent. Returns org_not_linked when organization_id is unset — dashboard claim/join is not released yet; do not invent join_org.

toolsPreview.name: agent_report_issue
toolsPreview.description: Report unexpected tool errors or confusing Conduit outcomes for AX review (agent_report_issue — not order_feedback). Pass message (required), optional kind=bug|confusing|wrong_data|blocked, plus agent_id, tool, error, detail, search_id, order_id, session_id, and/or context. Dedupes open reports with the same tool+error+correlation. Does not change reputation.

toolsPreview.name: payment_methods
toolsPreview.description: List or enable agent payment methods (action=list|enable) with friendly labels. Defaults: cod + x402. invoice (B2B) is coming_soon. bank_card is handoff-only.

toolsPreview.name: payment_mandate
toolsPreview.description: AP2 spend mandates. action=request (needs scope) → approval_url; list; update (mandate_id+scope); revoke (mandate_id). Widening needs human re-approval; narrowing applies immediately.

toolsPreview.name: supply_search
toolsPreview.description: Multi-provider discovery (live REAL merchants by default). Returns a ranked page (default limit=30, max 100) with total/has_more/next_offset. Follow next.args (search_id+offset+limit) to page without re-fanout. Optional fetch_limit (max 300) deepens the upstream pull on new searches. Pass include_sandbox=true only to append DEMO/SANDBOX test merchants at the bottom (testOffer=true). Always pass agent_id for mandate-aware badges. Carry search_id through supply_details / order_execute / order_feedback.

toolsPreview.name: supply_details
toolsPreview.description: Full normalized product detail from search cache. For shipping ETA/cost use supply_delivery. Re-run supply_search if offer_not_in_cache.

toolsPreview.name: supply_delivery
toolsPreview.description: Non-committing checkout probe for shipping ETA/cost. Uses agent default_destination, else linked org default address, or country override.

toolsPreview.name: order_execute
toolsPreview.description: Handoff or autonomous checkout. Autonomous needs badge payable_now + active mandate. Use idempotency_key. Prefer supply_delivery when only comparing delivery.

toolsPreview.name: order_list
toolsPreview.description: List orders for an agent ({ orders }). Optional status or open_only filter.

toolsPreview.name: order_track
toolsPreview.description: Honest deal-type-aware status (never fabricates carrier scans). Requires owning agent_id.

toolsPreview.name: order_events
toolsPreview.description: Lifecycle timeline — transitions only. Pair with order_track. Requires owning agent_id.

toolsPreview.name: order_update_status
toolsPreview.description: Agent manual correction or degraded handoff recovery. note required except cancelled. Owning agent_id required.

toolsPreview.name: order_dispute
toolsPreview.description: Refund/chargeback/report paths for an order. Requires owning agent_id.

toolsPreview.name: order_feedback
toolsPreview.description: Attest delivery outcome (outcome=on_time|late|never_arrived|damaged|wrong_item). Requires owning agent_id. Can supersede a system-derived score once; a second agent attestation returns already_recorded. Poor outcomes next→order_dispute. Omit quality/carrier_rating if unknown.
